About Me

Get to know the person behind the pixels. I'm a developer who believes that technology should feel warm and human.

?

Hello! I'm Leo-Martin

I'm a third year Informatics student at University of Tartu. My interest in Data Science and software development was sparked by the Generative AI explosion in 2022. Since then, I have been experimenting with how these technologies work under the hood.

I enjoy building personal projects to learn new tools. Recently, I developed an interactive voice-agent using Python, and an LLM-powered chess bot using Vue.js. I often leverage AI tools to accelerate my own coding and learning process.

In addition to my IT studies, I have a background in natural sciences (International Earth Science Olympiad bronze medalist), which helped hone my analytical thinking. I am currently looking for an internship in Data Science or AI Engineering to learn from experienced developers and tackle real-world problems.

When I'm Not Coding

I spend my free time walking in nature or cycling. I maintain mental balance through the Mindfulness Practices Tartu group. I'm active in the academic organization Põhjala (EÜS Põhjala) where I've served as House Manager and Archivist.

Chess has held a special place in my life – I've played in various competitions and taught it to elementary school children at Põlva Jakobi Kool. I also enjoy good books and audio learning materials.

I believe in the importance of balancing productivity and rest and try to maintain this in my daily life. I'm also a member of Kaitseliidu Küberkaitseüksus, where I participate in cybersecurity exercises and training.
